scope: CAD arithmetic against UNVERIFIED nominal HW-818 numbers

findings.title: Factory-soldered header pins cannot seat: V2 lifts the PCB only 3.5 mm
Board length exceeds the gap between V2 pillars
USB plug has nowhere to go: board long axis ends at an M3 pillar pair and a strap slot
V2 support pads sit under the header rows
Skin-side head pocket is shallower than an M3 pan head
V2 M3x16 recommendation happened to be long enough (kept for the record)
validate_cad.py comment says the CAD module "exports on import"; it does not (export is under __main__)

numbers.effect: V4 CAD checks validated the in-memory solid plus the previously exported STL; harmless but inaccurate

findings.title: V4 host tool sends CAPTURE immediately after opening the port

numbers.risk: if the HW-818 has the usual DTR/RTS auto-program circuit, opening the port resets the ESP32 and the request is lost
numbers.v5_change: --wait-ready option; evidence class for the reset circuit: UNKNOWN
